title: 100-Mode Rotated Gaussian Grid (Affine-Square Init Cohort)
intuition: Explicitly scoped affine-square init cohort variant of `rotated100`. Rotates the 10x10 Gaussian grid off the coordinate axes to verify that a trainer's 100-mode recovery is geometrically invariant and not exploiting axis-aligned separability.
failure_mode: Axis-biased quantizers, separable coordinate heuristics, or poorly conditioned generators leave bridge mass along rotated diagonals and miss precision or covariance gates.
protocol_notes: Explicit affine-square initialized 100-mode cohort testing initialization transfer sensitivity; separate from standard `deterministic_orthogonal`.
